in_marathi.name: Sharavathi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of rivers
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharavathi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sharavathi is the name of a goddess who is believed to be the protector of rivers. She is often depicted as a beautiful and graceful goddess who brings prosperity and fertility to the land.
